page.overview:
Who is Elena's family?

Jafari was born outside of the Majivu tribe, and married into it by wedding Amina.

Her white hair is a unique trait passed down through the Majivu tribe, which has been inherited by both of her children.

Amina (mother) Elena (younger sister) Unnamed wife Zuri (daughter)

He appears in the family portrait in Elena's ending in Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike and both her prologue and ending in Ultra Street Fighter IV alongside his father Jafari where he spars his younger sister, Elena in Capoeira. Marcus also appears in Street Fighter 6 at the Reniala Remains and the white cord that he wears from his background appearance is the highest rank attained in Capoeira.
